first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An adult man in the foreground with side-parted brown hair and a thin handlebar mustache, wearing a dark purple jacket with red piping, a white shirt, and a black bow tie, and holding a white note and a thin pen.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man behind and to the image-right of Person A, wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a purple cylindrical hat with two lines of gold lettering on the front.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red floor covering visible in the lobby passageway and seating area, with light-colored patterns and thin border lines in places.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The large dark green plant with pinnate leaves located behind Person A in the earlier part of the clip.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light pink, warm-toned walls of the lobby, with rectangular decorative sections, light-colored outlines, and arched openings.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The warm-white globe lights hanging high in the background, the small lights arranged along the edges of the arches, and the wall-mounted lights.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The upholstered chairs with wooden frames and armrests on both sides of the passageway, with light-colored cushions visible in the opening image and brown cushions visible on the image-right in the final frame.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The group of small tables beside the lounge chairs, with a dark curved tabletop and part of its support visible in the opening image, and only part of a tabletop visible in the final frame.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The people in the background other than Person A and Person B, including staff members in white aprons in front of the doorway, passersby, and guests in the seating area.

entities.name: dark flower stand
entities.identification: The dark brown stand supporting the pink-and-white floral decoration, with a flat top and upright legs visible.

entities.name: floor pattern band
entities.identification: The continuous narrow pattern band of alternating light and dark sections arranged along the side edge of the red patterned carpet, within the area visible in the image.

entities.name: pink-and-white floral decoration
entities.identification: The large clustered floral decoration on the dark flower stand, composed of dense white and light pink flowers and dark green leaves.
